faq.q1: How do I request a quote?
faq.a1: On the I want a website page, pick the type of site, the number of pages and the extras, and send the request to SeaTech over WhatsApp. The quote comes out of the conversation.
faq.q2: How much does a website cost?
faq.a2: Pricing isn't shown on the site. It's agreed directly with SeaTech, once we understand what your business needs.
faq.a3: It depends on the size of the site and on when the texts and photos are ready. The timeline is agreed with SeaTech together with the quote.
faq.q4: What's the difference between the three types of site?
faq.a4: The Company site has your company's pages and a contact form. The Catalogue with ordering shows products by section and brand and sends the list ready on WhatsApp. Complete has both, like the Distri Rio website.
faq.q5: Does WhatsApp ordering need a paid system?
faq.a5: On Distri Rio, no: the list becomes a WhatsApp link with the message already written, and the customer just hits send.
faq.q6: What do you need from me to get started?
faq.a6: The basics: your company name and logo, what you want to say on each page and the photos. For a catalogue, the product list. Anything missing gets sorted out in the conversation.
